director_notes_applied: With her, never ahead of her: two chase set-ups only (a tracking pass alongside her at hip height, a low reverse at the hedge foot), then the burrow entry.
The rabbit's drop into the burrow is seen past her shoulder — no shot in this episode knows more than Alice knows.
The far elm of S01 sits in the background of the hedge reverse, so the audience can see exactly what she is not turning to look at.
The last beat slows to nothing: her boots vanish, then ~3 s held on the empty hedge while the meadow sound drains to silence. That silence is the dream's front door.
Camera drops as she drops: 0.8-1.1 m running, 0.25 m at the burrow.

scenes.location: a short root-laced earth tunnel opening into a dream shaft 2.4 m across and about 6 m tall, dressed like the rooms of a house turned on end
scenes.color_ref: color_script ep01 act 2 — tarnished gold draining to slate/verdigris; the film's ONLY in-shot grade ramp runs across this scene and completes on the landing heap in S04. Directed as depth, not as a timeline: honey-gold survives on the topmost dressing and the jars, and each pass she falls through is cooler than the one above it. No daylight of any kind.
director_notes_applied: Three set-ups only, reused: (1) the locked wide with Alice held at one place in frame while the dressing slides up; (2) her POV straight down into black, used twice; (3) the profile close as she settles. No spinning camera, no vertigo move, no Dutch.

Each group is one dressed pass of the same shaft and the passes must be distinguishable: pass 1 glazed cupboards and jars, pass 2 bookshelves and schoolroom maps, pass 3 pictures on pegs and empty pegs. If the passes look alike the fall reads as a loop instead of a depth.
The fall is ENTERED from set-ups the hook did not use (the tunnel floor tipping, then tight on her back); the recognised wide is held back to 'Down, down, down' in group 2.
The marmalade jar plays as comedy of manners, not wonder — she looks in, is disappointed, holds it out to drop it, looks down, and decides not to.
ORANGE MARMALADE gets exactly one clean legible insert (whitelisted lettering, CR-012); off-axis everywhere else.
Falling asleep is one unbroken shot, held 2 s before Thump! Thump! — the audience must be able to point at the frame where the dream starts.
Required grouping A/B/C, because TR-04 enters B and TR-05 enters C.
scenes.deviation_note: 9 shots against the plan's ~6 / ASL ~8 s target. The drivers are structural, not appetite: both POV-straight-down inserts are separately required by the plan's seven-POV list, the three dressing passes have to be shown as distinct, and TR-04/TR-05 need group boundaries. Longest take is still 9.0 s (the sleep shot) and no set-up outside the licensed three is introduced. Flagged for shot-planning, which owns the final numbers.

shots_draft.content: Tight on her back as she drops: the tunnel mouth shrinks away above her, the fall slows to nothing like a fall, her skirts and pinafore billow and her hair pulls up. shots_draft.sketch: Low-angle wide from below her looking up the shaft toward the receding tunnel mouth, camera falling with her on her own axis, no horizon and no Dutch. She is held small and central; all the movement belongs to the dressing. The grade begins its ramp here — warm at the top of frame, cooler at the bottom.
shots_draft.action_ref: 动作: 'She falls, but slowly. Her skirts and pinafore billow; her hair floats up. The round walls of a deep well slide upward past her: glazed cupboards, bookshelves, maps and pictures hung on pegs, like the rooms of a house turned on end.'

CHAR-alice.action: drops through the tunnel mouth and the fall slows, body upright, skirts billowing, hair pulling up

shots_draft.content: Drifting level with the pantry shelf, she takes down a jar labelled ORANGE MARMALADE, looks inside — empty — and, disappointed, holds it out at arm's length to drop it.
shots_draft.sketch: Close across the open drop toward the pantry shelf, lens square-on to the label for the one clean legible read of ORANGE MARMALADE; her hands and the jar hold the frame, her face just above. The comedy is manners, not wonder: she is a careful child tidying up an impossible place.
shots_draft.action_ref: 动作: 'Drifting past a shelf, she takes down a jar labelled ORANGE MARMALADE. She looks inside: empty. Disappointment. She holds it out to drop it...'

CHAR-alice.action: takes the marmalade jar off the shelf, looks inside and holds it out at arm's length to drop it

shots_draft.content: Her POV straight down the open centre of the shaft: nothing, no floor, the last lamp-coloured glint dying out a long way below. The jar hangs in the top of frame in her hand.
shots_draft.sketch: POV looking straight down the shaft's open centre from her eye-line, no tile equivalent — the lens sits on her axis at the middle of the shaft aimed at the black below, with the glazed cupboards and the pantry shelf running away to a point at the edges of frame. Flat, still, no move.
shots_draft.action_ref: 动作: '...glances down into the black below...'

CHAR-alice.action: out of frame behind the lens, drifting upright with the jar held out

shots_draft.poses_note: Alice is not visible in this shot (POV / she has left frame); the entry records the body state she is in, so blocking and the whitebox still have her.

shots_draft.content: She thinks better of it and tucks the jar tidily into a glazed cupboard as it slides by; then, settling to the idea that this is going to go on for a while, she wonders aloud how many miles she has fallen.
shots_draft.sketch: Eye-level medium from the middle of the shaft toward the glazed cupboards, camera beside her, the cupboard doors travelling up through frame as she posts the jar into one. Her whole body in frame so the impossible calm reads. No move.
shots_draft.action_ref: 动作: '...thinks better of it, and tucks the jar into a cupboard as it slides by.'

dialogue_ref.speaker: CHAR-alice
dialogue_ref.text: I wonder how many miles I've fallen by this time?

CHAR-alice.action: posts the empty jar into a passing cupboard and looks about her as she falls

shots_draft.content: Down, down, down. The recognised wide: Alice held small at one place in frame while the second pass — bookshelves and schoolroom maps on pegs — slides steadily upward past her, each level cooler than the one above. She settles into the fall as if into an armchair, ankles crossing, hands coming to her lap, and talks about her cat.
shots_draft.sketch: Locked wide from the roundel wall straight across the shaft, the set-up the episode opened on, now recognised rather than re-watched; she keeps one place in frame so the fall reads as endless. The dissolve in from the previous group is what makes this a later moment of the same descent and not a new place.
shots_draft.action_ref: 动作: 'Down, down, down. The furniture keeps rising past her. She settles into the fall as if into an armchair; her voice softens.'

dialogue_ref.speaker: CHAR-alice
dialogue_ref.text: Dinah'll miss me very much to-night, I should think!

CHAR-alice.action: settles back into the fall as if into an armchair, ankles crossing, hands coming to her lap

shots_draft.content: Her POV straight down again: the same black, deeper and emptier than before, with nothing at all left in it to catch the light.
shots_draft.sketch: The set-up of shot 4 repeated exactly, on purpose — same lens, same axis down the open centre of the shaft, only the walls are now bookshelves and map pegs and the last glint is gone. The repetition is the measurement: this is how much further down she is.
shots_draft.action_ref: 动作: 'Down, down, down.' (the depth of the drop, played as the second of the two POVs listed in directing_plan)

CHAR-alice.action: out of frame behind the lens, settled back in the fall looking down

shots_draft.poses_note: Alice is not visible in this shot (POV / she has left frame); the entry records the body state she is in, so blocking and the whitebox still have her.

shots_draft.content: Profile close, hair floating up, the third pass behind her now — pictures on pegs and then bare empty pegs. Her voice softens to a whisper as she turns the question over and gets it the wrong way round.
shots_draft.sketch: Eye-level close from the middle of the shaft toward the bookshelf wall, camera beside her at her own height so the pegs and pictures travel up through the background behind her cheek; the dressing is thinning out, which is the only warning that the fall is nearly over. No move.
shots_draft.action_ref: 动作: 'Down, down, down... her voice softens.'

dialogue_ref.speaker: CHAR-alice
dialogue_ref.text: Do cats eat bats? Do cats eat bats?… Do bats eat cats?

CHAR-alice.action: drifts settled back with ankles crossed, whispering the question to herself

shots_draft.content: One unbroken shot: her eyes close, her head tips to one side, and Alice is asleep as she falls. Held. The last empty pegs clear the top of frame and the dark takes her; two heavy thumps land over it.
shots_draft.sketch: The same profile close as shot 8, unbroken from the eyes closing through the two-second hold to the dark — no cut, no dissolve inside it, so the audience can point at the frame where the dream starts even though nothing announces it. The hollow hush and the tick of an unseen clock are the only sound until the thumps.
shots_draft.action_ref: 动作: 'Her eyes close. Her head tips to one side. Alice is asleep as she falls.' / 声音: 'Thump! Thump!'

CHAR-alice.action: lets her eyes close and her head tip to one side, asleep as she falls

groups_draft.beat: group A — tunnel crawl, the drop, the first pass, the marmalade jar
groups_draft.rationale: The director's required group A. One dressed pass of the shaft (glazed cupboards and jars) so the group has a single visual identity. Sizes run wide - wide - close - wide POV - medium, and the long slow fall is broken by the jar business, which is the only thing in the group with a beginning and an end.

transition_in.reason: TR-03: the dream must not be announced. The dark oval of the burrow mouth and the frame of the earth tunnel are aligned so the cut is invisible as a cut; the register change lands 20 s later on the grade. scenes.scene_name: INT The Landing Heap and the Long Passage
scenes.location: a dark landing chamber hung with a curtain of pale hawthorn roots, a heap of sticks and dry leaves, and a long low passage running away brick-vaulted to a right-angle corner and the opening into the long hall
scenes.color_ref: color_script ep01 act 2→3 — the only in-shot ramp COMPLETES on the landing heap in shot 1; from there the full dream grade holds (verdigris/slate with warm amber passage lamplight). No daylight anywhere.
director_notes_applied: THE MOST IMPORTANT INSTRUCTION IN THE EPISODE — the White Rabbit is a quadruped. The delivered character sheet has him upright like a person (runs/g4/gate.json waiver, reroll budget 0), so it is directed around: he moves at a real rabbit's gait on four legs, and to read the watch he STOPS and SITS BACK ON HIS HAUNCHES with the watch braced in a paw against his chest, then drops to four and goes. No bipedal walk cycle, no human gesture; speech carried by muzzle, ears and eyes. The corrective wording is mandatory in the prompt of every group he appears in.
Distance discipline: never closer to him than a medium-wide in this scene. His face is spent once, in S08.
The watch is read in ONE insert of the watch face and the paw, not on his face.
He never looks at Alice in S04.
Landing and 'jumps to her feet' in one shot, shot low so the leaves settle inside the frame.
Camera at child height 1.20-1.35 m, never adult height.

shots_draft.content: Alice lands on a heap of sticks and dry leaves; she is not a bit hurt and jumps to her feet at once, looking up — all dark overhead. The leaves she threw up settle back inside the frame.
shots_draft.sketch: Low medium from the root-laced earth stretch back at the leaf heap, lens 0.6 m rising to 1.3 m with her; the root curtain hangs across the top of frame and there is nothing above it but black. One shot, no cut between the landing and her getting up. The dream grade reaches full strength here and holds for the rest of the episode.
shots_draft.action_ref: 动作: 'Alice lands on a heap of sticks and dry leaves. She is not a bit hurt; she jumps to her feet at once and looks up — all dark overhead.'

CHAR-alice.action: lands on her back on the heap of sticks and leaves and jumps straight to her feet, looking up into the dark

shots_draft.content: Before her runs a long, low passage. Far down it the White Rabbit is hurrying away from her on four legs: a white rabbit in a smart checked silk waistcoat, a pair of white kid gloves carried in his mouth.
shots_draft.sketch: Wide from the leaf heap down the whole long low passage, lens 1.3 m, deep-staged on the brick vault so he is genuinely far away and in profile — the cheapest insurance against the uncanny. Alice is a dark back-of-head and shoulder at the very edge of the near foreground. Real rabbit gait, all four feet, no human carriage.
shots_draft.action_ref: 动作: 'Before her runs a long, low passage. Far down it, the White Rabbit is hurrying away: a white rabbit in a smart waistcoat, a pair of white kid gloves in one paw.'

CHAR-alice.action: stands on the leaf heap with her back to camera, watching him go

CHAR-white-rabbit.action: hurries away down the passage on all four legs, gloves carried in his mouth

shots_draft.content: He stops, sits back on his haunches, takes a large watch out of his waistcoat-pocket and braces it in a paw against his chest to read it — and frets about the time. He does not look back at Alice.
shots_draft.sketch: The same medium-wide down the passage, no closer; he is a small clear silhouette against the lamplight, the gloves dropped between his forefeet. The whole performance is muzzle, ears and the set of his back — the posture is a real rabbit sitting up, not a person standing. Clean single on him so the native dialogue take has one speaker in frame.
shots_draft.action_ref: 动作: 'He takes a large watch out of his waistcoat-pocket and looks at it.'

dialogue_ref.speaker: CHAR-white-rabbit
dialogue_ref.text: Oh dear! Oh dear! I shall be late!

CHAR-white-rabbit.action: sits back on his haunches and braces the pocket watch in one paw against his chest to read it

shots_draft.content: Insert: the watch face and the paw that holds it, lit by passage lamplight. Two o'clock is long past.
shots_draft.sketch: Insert taken from the middle of the brick-vaulted passage, lens on the watch itself, no tile equivalent — the frame is the enamel dial, the chain and the fur and claws of a real rabbit's forepaw closed round it, warm lamplight raking across the glass. His face is not in this shot. The one image of the scene.
shots_draft.action_ref: 动作: 'He takes a large watch out of his waistcoat-pocket and looks at it.'

CHAR-white-rabbit.action: holds the watch braced in one forepaw against his chest

shots_draft.content: Alice stares — the waistcoat-pocket, the watch — and then she is off after him like the wind, leaves flying from her skirt as she runs past camera down the passage.
shots_draft.sketch: Wide from the brick-vaulted middle of the passage back toward the dark landing chamber, lens 1.25 m; she comes out of the black toward us and clears frame low and close, dry leaves lifting off her pinafore. The only fast shot in the scene.
shots_draft.action_ref: 动作: 'Alice stares — the waistcoat-pocket, the watch. Then she is off after him like the wind, leaves flying from her skirt.'

CHAR-alice.action: stares after him, then runs past camera down the passage with leaves flying off her skirt

shots_draft.content: At the far end the White Rabbit drops back onto four legs, still muttering about the time, and turns the right-angle corner past the mosaic dado.
shots_draft.sketch: Medium past the pastel-and-gold mosaic dado to the right-angle corner glowing beyond it, lens 1.3 m; he is small in the frame and going away, and the drop from haunches to four legs happens in shot so the grammar is established and never contradicted. Clean single again for the line.
shots_draft.action_ref: 动作: 'At the far end the White Rabbit turns a corner, still muttering.'

dialogue_ref.speaker: CHAR-white-rabbit
dialogue_ref.text: Oh my ears and whiskers, how late it's getting!

CHAR-white-rabbit.action: drops from his haunches onto four legs and goes round the corner at a run

shots_draft.content: Alice rounds the corner close behind him — and stops. Beyond her, the long hall opening.
shots_draft.sketch: Low close from the hall threshold back at the corner as she rounds it at a run, lens 1.2 m; she arrives into the frame and brakes, and the shot ends hard on the stop. The scene's only job was to hand the audience the goal, and this is the moment it is handed over.
shots_draft.action_ref: 动作: 'Alice rounds the corner close behind him — and stops.'

CHAR-alice.action: rounds the corner at a run and pulls up short

groups_draft.beat: she lands, and the goal is introduced: a rabbit with a watch, far down a passage
groups_draft.rationale: One introduce-the-goal beat. Medium - wide - medium-wide - detail, with the insert supplying the close the distance discipline refuses to give his face. The only fast thing in the group is the leaves settling; he is kept at distance and in profile throughout.

scenes.location: a long, low, windowless hall 31.7 m long under a 2.80 m vault: eleven gilt-halo lamps at 2.30 m on the centre line, horseshoe-arched oak doors 1.95 m high all round, verdigris iron whiplash ribs, a mosaic dado, a three-legged glass table 0.715 m high, and a low curtain hiding a 0.38 m door
scenes.color_ref: color_script ep01 act 3 — verdigris/slate with warm amber lamp pools and ONE bright keyhole of garden green. Per the director's interim ruling on DEF-p6-directing-ep01-001, the pastel dose is carried by jewel glints and lead-came sheen on the BLIND roundels near each lamp and by the pastel tulip shades — surfaces and glints, not cast light. The only coloured cast light in the hall is the garden green through the little door.
scenes.scene_split_note: Shots 1-6 are staged on the SCN-long-hall layout pack; shots 7-11 are staged on the SCN-little-door-passage pack, whose hall_floor landmark is the flagstones in front of the little door. Groups are split on that boundary so no group straddles two layout packs.
director_notes_applied: Reveal the room in one move, not one cut: the hall's 31.7 m length and its 2.80 m vault registered in the same shot, while Alice is still normal-sized and can be measured against them. This is the engine of every scale beat in S06-S09.
The door round is two shots, not twenty (pacing T2): one tracking pass with her hand hitting handle after handle inside one frame, then a cut to the return pass already failing.
The glass table is established here as the brightest object in the hall.

The garden glimpse is built from exactly three shots: the key and the door opening, her POV down the rat-hole passage, and the return to her face lit by that green. Shot 3 is the wonder peak — hold it.
The POV is deliberately flat and small in frame: the garden must look like a keyhole, not a place we could walk into. The dream's one longer lens is spent here.
The little door's horseshoe arch gives the episode its ONE Mucha halo-roundel composition.
Longing is played with her body, not with tears: forehead to the frame, pull back, sit on her heels. Nothing is pre-spent.
62 s with no dialogue — the longest dialogue-free stretch in the episode. No music until the curtain.
Camera at child height 1.20-1.35 m.

shots_draft.content: Alice steps in at the corner entrance under its 2.45 m lintel and the hall opens out in front of her: a long, low, windowless hall lit by a row of lamps hanging from the roof, each in a gilt halo with tulip shades glowing amber; verdigris iron ribs curling in whiplash scrolls across a shallow vault of faded gilded vines; iron lily-stems up the honey limestone walls above a mosaic dado; horseshoe-arched oak doors all round with a small stained-glass roundel over each. No Rabbit anywhere.
shots_draft.sketch: The episode's one hall reveal, in a single slow lateral-and-back move from just inside the corner entrance down the long hall to the glass table. Alice is kept in frame against the vault the whole way, so 31.7 m of length and 2.80 m of height are registered together and the ceiling reads as barely above an adult's reach. Lamp pools on the flag floor, brown-black between them; the roundels catch only faint jewel glints of lamplight and are never backlit.
shots_draft.action_ref: 动作: 'A long, low, windowless hall lit by a row of lamps hanging from the roof... No Rabbit anywhere.'

CHAR-alice.action: steps in under the corner entrance lintel and walks slowly into the hall, looking along it

shots_draft.content: The door round, first pass: Alice works down the locked doors of the west wall, her hand hitting handle after handle inside the same frame — locked, locked, locked.
shots_draft.sketch: Travelling medium from the centre of the hall under the lamps toward the west-wall doors, lens 1.3 m, moving with her so three or four black iron handles and their horseshoe arches pass through one continuous frame. The repetition is compressed into the move instead of into cuts.
shots_draft.action_ref: 动作: 'Alice tries the doors: down one side of the hall, rattling handle after handle — locked, locked, locked — and up the other side.'

CHAR-alice.action: walks the west wall trying handle after handle without stopping

shots_draft.content: Cut to the return pass already failing: her hand on a large black iron handle of the east wall, pulling hard. The handle does not move. All locked.
shots_draft.sketch: Close toward one locked door of the east wall from the centre of the hall, lens 1.25 m, static — the first still frame since the reveal. Her hand and the iron fill the frame with the mosaic dado and one blind roundel above; we join the second pass already defeated, so the audience never has to watch it happen.
shots_draft.action_ref: 动作: '...and up the other side. All locked.'

CHAR-alice.action: hauls at a big iron door handle on the east wall and gives it up

shots_draft.content: She walks slowly back down the middle of the hall, looking about her for any way out — and comes upon a little three-legged table made all of solid glass.
shots_draft.sketch: Wide down the hall from the corner entrance, lens 1.3 m, static: she comes toward camera under the lamp row with the glass table catching the light ahead of her, so the table announces itself before she reaches it. Deep staging, the lamp row running away overhead as the top layer.
shots_draft.action_ref: 动作: 'She walks slowly back down the middle of the hall, looking about her for any way out. She comes upon a little three-legged table made all of solid glass.'

CHAR-alice.action: walks back down the middle of the hall looking about her and stops at the glass table

shots_draft.content: On the table lies nothing but a tiny golden key, alone in the middle of a bare glass sheet at 0.715 m — waist height to her. Her face lights up and her hand comes in to take it.
shots_draft.sketch: Low close from the floor at the curtain back toward the glass table, lens 0.5 m so the tabletop reads as a lit plane with the three clear legs beneath; the key is the brightest object in the frame and the hall is established here as holding it that way for the whole size sequence. Her face is a soft shape above the glass.
shots_draft.action_ref: 动作: 'On it lies nothing but a tiny golden key. Her face lights up.'

CHAR-alice.action: leans over the glass tabletop and picks up the tiny golden key

shots_draft.content: She carries the key from door to door: two tries and it is plain. The key is far too small for every lock — swallowed by an iron keyhole four times its size.
shots_draft.sketch: Travelling medium back along the west doors, lens 1.3 m, the same axis as shot 2 so the failure rhymes with the first pass; two attempts inside the move and then out. The scale joke is in the frame, not in the number of tries.
shots_draft.action_ref: 动作: 'She carries it from door to door; it is far too small for every lock.'

CHAR-alice.action: tries the golden key in two big door locks and finds it hopelessly small

shots_draft.content: On her second time round she notices a low curtain she had passed before. She lifts it — and behind it is a little door about fifteen inches high under a horseshoe arch.
shots_draft.sketch: Medium from beside the neighbouring locked hall door along the base of the wall, lens dropping 1.3 m to 0.9 m as she crouches; the curtain comes away and the tiny horseshoe arch with its stained-glass roundel above makes the episode's single Mucha halo-roundel composition — one clean symmetrical framing, spent here and nowhere else.
shots_draft.action_ref: 动作: 'On her second time round she notices a low curtain she had passed before. She lifts it: behind it, a little door about fifteen inches high.'

CHAR-alice.action: lifts the low curtain aside and crouches down to the little door behind it

shots_draft.content: Her hands turn the golden key in the tiny lock. It turns. Her face breaks into delight, and she pushes the fifteen-inch door open.
shots_draft.sketch: Low medium from the hall floor at kneeling height toward the tiny horseshoe-arched door, lens 0.4 m; her kneeling body fills the right of frame and the door the left, so the 0.38 m door is measured against her 1.35 m the moment it opens. The first green touches the flagstones as the leaf swings in.
shots_draft.action_ref: 动作: 'She tries the golden key. It turns. Her face breaks into delight. She opens the little door and kneels.'

CHAR-alice.action: kneels at the little door, turns the golden key and pushes the leaf open

shots_draft.content: Her POV along the passage: a small stone passage not much larger than a rat-hole, iron ribs along it, and at its far end in full high summer sunlight the loveliest garden — beds of bright flowers, cool fountains throwing spray.
shots_draft.sketch: Wide through the little door straight along the stone passage to the garden arch, lens at her kneeling eye-line; the dream's one long lens, deliberately flat, so the garden compresses into a small bright postcard at the end of a slate tunnel and cannot be mistaken for somewhere we could walk into. It is the only warm meadow-green in the dream half of the episode — the goal coloured as the waking world she has just left.
shots_draft.action_ref: 动作: 'Beyond it runs a small passage, not much larger than a rat-hole, and at its far end, in full summer sunlight — the loveliest garden: beds of bright flowers, cool fountains throwing spray.'

CHAR-alice.action: out of frame behind the lens, kneeling at the open little door

shots_draft.poses_note: Alice is not visible in this shot (POV / she has left frame); the entry records the body state she is in, so blocking and the whitebox still have her.

shots_draft.content: Back to her face at the doorway, lit by that green. The wonder peak of the episode — held.
shots_draft.sketch: The reverse along the tile-1 axis: lens at the little door's threshold looking back up at her face on the flagstones in front of it, so the garden light is a hard green-gold edge across one cheek and one eye while the rest of her stays in lamp amber. Static, held to the end of the shot. Hold it — this is the highest point of the first half.
shots_draft.action_ref: 动作: 'She opens the little door and kneels.' (her reaction to the garden; played silently per adaptation_note)

CHAR-alice.action: kneels at the open little door with the garden light on her face, not moving

shots_draft.content: She leans in until her forehead is pressed to the door frame. Her head will not go through. She pulls back and sits down on her heels, looking from the little door to her own shoulders — longing written all over her, and not one tear.
shots_draft.sketch: Low medium from the hall floor at kneeling height, lens 0.4 m, static: the whole beat is her body against the 0.38 m opening — forehead to the frame, the shoulders that are plainly too wide, the retreat onto her heels. Faint fountains and a bird from the garden end; lamp hiss and her breathing in the hall. The episode cries twice later, so nothing is spent here.
shots_draft.action_ref: 动作: 'Alice leans in until her forehead is pressed to the door frame. Her head will not go through. She pulls back and sits on her heels, looking from the little door to her own shoulders, longing written all over her.'

CHAR-alice.action: presses her forehead to the little door frame, pulls back and sits down on her heels

groups_draft.rationale: The establish-and-defeat beat. Wide (moving) - medium (moving) - close (static), so the group lands on its only still frame; the door round is compressed into two shots per pacing T2 and the 8 s saved is spent on the reveal and the garden.

scenes.color_ref: color_script ep01 act 4 — still held flat, the glass table still the brightest object; no re-lighting between S06 and S07 so the size changes read through the sets

director_notes_applied: Mirror of S06 shot with the opposite grammar: S06's key set-up was the floor looking up, S07's is the lamp line looking down.

The growth is measured in three gauges IN SEQUENCE: table sinks to her knee (0.715 m) → the lamps come down to her shoulder (2.30 m) → her head meets an iron rib of the vault (2.80 m) and old gilding sifts down. Real whitebox numbers, so it is a staging problem and not a VFX one.

The cake reasoning MOVES: LN-013/013b/014 is staged as one continuous crossing of the floor that ends back at the glass box — no static talking head. The speech stays inside one group and every line is whole inside its shot.
The deflation is a real hold: after 'Which way? Which way?' nothing happens — two full seconds on her disappointed face before the rise begins. The comedy is entirely in that timing.
'Good-bye, feet!' is one shot down her own body to her feet far below, with the same black ankle-strap boots we watched vanish under the hedge in S02.
At 2.74 m she can never be framed standing: every giant frame is a hunch, a lie-down or a fragment. When she is huge we go close and let the room be implied; the widescreen frame becomes the cage.
EAT ME gets exactly one clean legible insert (whitelisted lettering, CR-012).
The vault knock in shot 10 is the LAST shot in the film that contains a lamp fixture.

director_notes_applied: From the first frame of S08 the camera is below 1.0 m and stays there for the rest of the episode. That is the only way giant Alice (2.74 m) and the act-5 'lamps out of frame' rule (lamp line 2.30 m) can both be true.
Movement 1 — few shots, long takes, camera on the flagstones at water level, her face mostly above frame. We are down in the consequence, not up with the emotion.

Movement 2 — the one fast passage in the episode: quadruped gait through four inches of water, displaced water, wet leg fur, ripples starting under his feet, exact eyeline. His look up — and up — is the episode's one two-step camera move: a tilt that runs out of room before it finds her face.

Movement 3 — ONE sustained set-up on her face, broken exactly twice: once for her hands, once for the look up into the vault, which is the only up-angle in the whole episode. '…who in the world am I?' lands and ends inside one shot with a clean line-end. No music until that look up.

Movement 4 — the four required shots in order: (a) the glove that fits, (b) the glance to a table that is taller than it was, (c) the fan still moving while the table edge rises past frame, (d) she stops the fan and the shrinking stops IN THE SAME FRAME.
Tone guard: the flood is warm, slow and absurd, never drowning menace. Dread belongs to S10.
Quadruped rabbit, again mandatory in the prompt of every group he appears in (G4 char-sheet waiver).
scenes.staging_decision: The screenplay gives the Rabbit 'a pair of white kid gloves in one hand and a large fan in the other' while he is trotting. Directed to fit CR-003/CR-015 without touching a word of the script: he carries both in his mouth while he runs on four legs, and transfers them to his forepaws when he sits back on his haunches to speak. The drop then plays exactly as written. Flagged to the director rather than resolved as a script change.

director_notes_applied: The camera is IN the water with her, lens just above the surface, at her 0.61 m scale, for the whole scene. No high or crane view from above — there is no rescuing god's-eye in this episode.
